description: This file defines the `absl::string_view` class, a lightweight, non-owning view into a string or character array, designed as a drop-in replacement for C++17's `std::string_view`. It includes constructors, member functions, comparison operators, and utility functions related to string views.

classes.name: absl::string_view
classes.description: A lightweight, non-owning view into a string or character array, with methods for string manipulation, comparison, and iteration.

methods.name: ClippedSubstr
methods.description: Returns a substring of a string_view, clipping the starting position to the string's size.

methods.name: NullSafeStringView
methods.description: Creates a string_view from a possibly-null C-string pointer, returning an empty view if null.
